title: feat(record): one header row and one button group on the record page (#35593, #35419)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgEV9LRY8FfTWS7J6T3MwsSL)_

Fixes #35593
Fixes #35419

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb8qTxAVaE2QKwquQU

## What changes

The record page's header is one 44 px row, with one button group (epic #35590).

- **Full page.** `page:header` draws into the page's top bar instead of a second row under it. Left: object icon, object name, `/`, record name, stage tag, approval tag. Right: n/m, ↓ ↑, a divider, the button group, ⊟.
- **Drawer.** The pane's bar takes the same header: object icon, record name, stage tag, approval tag; then the button group, ↗ (open as page) and ✕. No object name, no n/m, no ↓ ↑ once the header holds the bar. The j / k keys stay.
- **One button group by state** (`DeclaredActionsBar` header face):
  - Normal: Edit, ONE primary, ⋯. In the bar the default inline budget is 1; an authored `maxVisible` still wins.
  - Pending on me: 通过 (the only filled button), 驳回, then ⋮ with the other approval levers, a separator, and the record's actions.
  - My submission pending: 撤回, 催办, ⋮ (resubmit leads when the request is returned).
  - Override-only admin: the amber override menu ahead of the group.
  - Phone: the bottom bar draws the same group; 通过 is the only filled button (#35419).
- **The approval band goes away** on the record page. A short tag (待你审批 / 审批中 / 已退回修改 / 已驳回) sits after the record's name. It scrolls to the approvals panel (`record-approvals-panel`) until the 审批 tab (#35595) exists.
- **Locks.** An approval lock draws no Edit, and the DetailView band draws no 「审批中已锁定」 badge once the header's tag names the approval (`InlineEditProvider` `approvalTagDrawnByHost`; the tag's tooltip says why; the tally stays). A state lock keeps Edit greyed and shows its lock tag beside the name (in the bar) or as before (no bar).
- **Reject needs a reason.** Area ruling: client-side only, in the record page's reject dialog (`requireRejectReason` maps `comment` to `required`). The declaration and the approvals list are unchanged.
- **Kept.** The request page's `ApprovalDecisionPanel` band and its pins are unchanged. A record layout with no `page:header` keeps the old band above its body as a fallback (counted through `ApprovalGroupBeacon`), so its decisions never vanish.

New in `@object-ui/react`: `InlineEditProvider` `approvalTagDrawnByHost`. New in `@object-ui/components`: `RecordHeaderBarContext` (the host bar's two slots and a claim) and `RecordHeaderStateContext` (tags + group). `RecordTopBar` / `NavigationOverlay` take `actionSlotRef`; `NavigationOverlay` also takes `stepperHidden`; `PageHeaderActions` takes `defaultMaxVisible`. Bar height `sm:h-10` → `sm:h-11`.

## Why

Card #35593 (Twenty-style record header, structure and sizes only, no code copied): three stacked bands became one row, and the approval's levers were a second button group competing with the record's.

## Verification

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

### Acceptance, #35593

| Item | Reading | Where |
|---|---|---|
| 1 one 44 px row, full page | ✓ | `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` (`drawsInBar`, `recordStageTag`), `RecordDetailView.tsx` (`pageHeaderBar`, `barTitleSlotEl`), `record-top-bar.tsx` (`actionSlotRef`, `sm:h-11`) |
| 2 drawer header | ✓ | `recordDrawerStack.tsx` (`headerBar`, `stepperHidden`, `onExpand`) |
| 3 one group by state | ✓ | `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx` (`headerLeads`, `SUBMITTER_LEAD_VERBS`), `containers.tsx` (`stateGroup`), `defaultMaxVisible={inBar ? 1 : undefined}` |
| 4 band → tag | ✓ (tag scrolls to the approvals panel until #35595) | `RecordDetailView.tsx` (`approvalTag`, `recordHeaderState`) |
| 5 lock badge / toast | badge ✓; toast: see deviations | `RecordDetailView.tsx` (`affordances.edit && !approvalLocked`, `approvalTagDrawnByHost`, `stateLockChip`), `DetailView.tsx` (badge gate), `InlineEditContext.tsx` |
| 6 reject reason | ✓ client-side | `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx` (`staticParams = requireReason && routeVerb === 'reject'`) |

### Acceptance, #35419

| Item | Reading | Where |
|---|---|---|
| phone, pending on me: only 通过 filled | ✓ | `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx` (`headerTone`, `data-header-tone`); pinned in `RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058.test.tsx` |
| 驳回 wording | ✓ already shipped on main (zh-CN `approval_reject` = 「驳回」) | no change |

### A1–A5 readings

- A1 holds: 撤回 = `approval_recall`, 催办 = `approval_remind`; both declared; the record page no longer excludes remind.
- A2: one primary holds; the default budget of 3 is set to 1 in the one-row header (area-approved plan).
- A3: surface amended by the area (drawer composition, the context file and its export). Amended after the fact (7026413128) for `ui/packages/react/src/context/InlineEditContext.tsx`: a host-only prop `approvalTagDrawnByHost`, default off, so every host that never passes it keeps the band's badge unchanged. Why: card item 5 says an approval lock draws no lock badge. The record page's header tag already names the approval, and the band in `@object-ui/plugin-detail` only learns what the host draws through `InlineEditProvider`, the same way `approvalRecallDrawnByHost` (#25877) works. Placement only; it never decides whether the record is locked. Clause-② stays no.
- A4: the lock badge lives in the DetailView band; it now yields to the header's tag for an approval lock. No toast path exists (see deviations).
- A5: the phone bar is `PageHeaderActions`' `bar` face portalled into the page's action bar; it now calls the state group too.

### Tests

New pins:
- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-record-bar-35593.test.tsx` (8): bar claim and portal, budget 1, authored `maxVisible`, `recordChrome: false`, tags, state group modes.
- `RecordDetailView.approvalDeclaredActions.test.tsx` (+7): approver / submitter / unrelated / override / no request, approval tag, reject reason required.
- `record-top-bar-27524.test.tsx` (+1): action slot order and empty hiding.
- `DetailView.approvalTagHostDrawn-35593.test.tsx` (3): no approval-lock badge when the host draws the tag; kept otherwise; an editable approval keeps its badge.

Migrated (record page only; the request page's band pins are untouched):
- `RecordDetailView.phoneFace-27058` (#35016 desktop and phone, #35099/#35135 approval-lock controls).
- `RecordDetailView.userActionPredicates` (approval lock: no Edit), `RecordDetailView.editLockedByState-32756`.
- `RecordDetailView.topBar-27524` (crumb → `/` + header H1; drawer: no crumb/counter, j steps).
- `RecordDetailView.headerMenuIcons-12529`, `accessibleNames-12625`, `placedHeaderActions-29951` (budget 1).
- `RecordDetailView.headerRefresh`, `childWriteRefreshesParent-12244`, `printPageHeaderActions-12906`, `recordPageTiers-26678`, `harness` (header row is in the top bar).
- e2e class reads: `record-flow-phone-targets.spec.ts` (`sm:h-11`), `record-header-title-width.spec.ts` (anchor on the row's own chip).

`RecordDetailView.editLockedByState-32756` now reads the approval lock off the tag (no band badge).

CI-only stall (Test UI shard 12 on e1989c8c): `RecordDetailView.approvalDeclaredActions.test.tsx`'s `@object-ui/react` mock factory imported `@object-ui/components`, which imports `@object-ui/react`; the factory awaited the module it was building and the file hung at collection, with no test clock running. Reproduced locally (300 s timeout, every describe); fixed in 5ff9d4dc (context handed through the hoisted holder), file now 20/20 in ~10 s.

Retired: none. The record-page band expectations in `RecordDetailView.approvalDeclaredActions.test.tsx` now read the header-less fallback band.

Checklist: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json` `approvals.record-page-decisions` revision 10 (steps 2, 4, 7, 9; acceptance 0, 1, 3, 4; source 0).

Gates: `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check green; `dispatch-gates --commands` set green locally (`check:new-line-citations` is not a script on this tree); `overlap-check --branch=HEAD` clean.

Screenshots (showcase, 1280×800 zh-CN and 390, DSF 2), in the project files `objectstack-seat5/area-ux/ux-4/record/card-35593/`: approver (EXP-2001, 通过 / 驳回 / ⋮, menu), submitter (Mei: 撤回 / 催办 / ⋮), unrelated on a locked record (Ada: 审批中 tag, ⋯ only, no Edit), unrelated without access to the request (no tag), approver who is also submitter, reject dialog (审批意见 required; empty confirm stays open), next step locked, after approval (编辑 + ⋯, no tag), 390 approver (only 通过 filled) and submitter, drawer.

### Deviations

- Item 5: no toast when edit is triggered while locked. Under an approval lock there is no Edit to trigger, and no other edit trigger exists on the page today.
- The approval's detail (step, submitter, tally) stays in the approvals panel and the DetailView band until #35595's 审批 tab.
- The drawer's ⋯ keeps its 「Open as full page」 item beside the new ↗.
- The approvals panel keeps its own remind beside the header's 催办.
- Edit removal is for approval locks only; a state lock keeps a greyed Edit.
- An authored subtitle is not drawn in the one-row header.
- The drawer keeps its existing ⤢ (maximize) beside ↗ and ✕.
- Follow-ups: #35659 and #35660 (filed by the area).
